marta: Postmortem follow-up  we need owners and explicit handoffs for the action list. Suggest weekly sherpa + 48h overlap. Starting tickets: RW-3501, RW-3504, RW-3509. Who can sherpa week 1?
oliver: I can take week 1. I'll own RW-3501 (cache compaction tuning) and RW-3509 (alert noise reduction).
priya: Thanks Oliver. Please add acceptance criteria and a short smoke-test checklist in each ticket so SRE can verify after deploy.
oliver: Adding ACs now. RW-3501 -> "95th latency <= target or revert flag applied within 30m"; RW-3509 -> "alert volume down by 70% in staging window". Smoke steps included.
rachel: I can be the backstop for week 1. If Oliver is blocked, I'll pick up the deploy.
oncall-bot: Reminder: PM action owner checklist due in 4 days for incident 2024-06-10.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-3309: "Remediation sprint - sherpa week 1" and linked RW-3501, RW-3504, RW-3509.
marta: Great. Oliver please post ticket links when updated and set sprint label so ops dashboards pick them up. Daily 10m stand for the week. Closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
